claims.citation: New York Herald, 28 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Bark Crested Wave (Br), Laker, Patras 85 days, with cur-
rants and rags, to Ralli & Co. Since April 7, had light and
variable winds, no NE trades. May 24, lat 34 30, lon 70 17,
spoke schr Gen Caszeau[?], from New York for St Domingo.
